conventions.vertical: 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p bt709, source fps (24/23.976/30/60) - map renderer time t to frame floor(t*fps) (mod frames when loopable)
conventions.peak_times: seconds from the start of the vertical file (local maxima of mean luma); global_peak = brightest moment
conventions.black_level: 5th-percentile luma (0-255), median over frames, measured on the vertical file; <=3 means truly black
conventions.matte: white = area covered by ink/liquid; use as luminance mask for the INCOMING shot
conventions.restricted: Mixkit items under the "Mixkit Restricted License" (720p personal-use previews) were screened but excluded
